items.title: Paul Barbarin Interview, 1957-03-27
items.q: Why didn't he want to play something like Steve Lewis? You know what I mean? He didn't know that type of playing. He was pretty good. Pretty good player at that time.

ctx.x: As a solo or with bass? Yeah, I mean it's... Why didn't he want to play something like Steve Lewis? You know what I mean? He didn't know that type of playing. He was pretty good. Pretty good player at that time. I don't know how he used to do it because I haven't waited many years, you know. But that Olympia band was a good band for the captain. I can't recall the bass, bro.
That's alright. Tell us about when you started to take up music. What did you start on?
